title: KQL: summarize, extend and project event data
objective_text: Pick the KQL operator for filtering, adding columns, choosing columns, counting per time bucket and sampling rows, and say why.
scenario: Operators are learning KQL to explore sensor events in an eventhouse. Their first queries mix up the operators that filter, reshape and aggregate.
verifies: You can pick the right feature, setting or operator for each scenario, with the reason and source shown afterwards.
does_not_verify: That you can do it in Fabric: nothing is set up or run here. Doing it on a real item is FABRIC VERIFIED work.

validation.fail: Not all right yet: reread the lesson's notes and try again.

explanation: Each question's answer, reason and source page are shown after a pass or on request.
